Name: LMGT3 Mercedes AMG GT3
Author: Redadeg (lmu-dashboards.com)
Description: Converted for the FX Pro by FX Unleashed from Redadeg's SimHub dash "LMGT3 Mercedes AMG GT3" (https://lmu-dashboards.com).
